milestones.description: S5 历史人门已通过。2026-10-14 Owner 确认 S1-P-07 无限取料及 S1-P-08 棒身全段可抓、取消 Q/E/局内重开、失败单个小烟云。S6 当前候选已完成 15 帧隔离真浏览器自玩、药液特效/紫汤/触控/宽屏、31 项定向测试、UI 审计和对齐单收敛；通用棒身能力含快照确定性修复，经异人独立复查 PASS 并释放公共工单。S6 整体终复查、Owner 美术平台逐行复核及 Owner 人门仍未通过；不沿用旧指纹判词。 2026-10-14 local S6 UI follow-up: result modal centered on stage, rack hover sheen and larger hit region, liquid-only add/stir glow. Independent reviewer reran 17-frame browser probe (0 errors), 10 focused tests, and UI audit; partial PASS only. Full S6 review, Owner art review and Owner gate remain pending. 2026-10-14 Owner 5173 visual follow-up: liquid-only high-contrast cue lasting 1400ms including static reduced-motion feedback; live 5173 browser probe 18 frames, zero errors, centered modal in 1135/1440/2500 viewports; independent partial review PASS. Owner visual confirmation and S6 full gate remain pending. 2026-10-15 local continuity candidate: add/stir liquid now crossfades old color for 750ms, glow attacks 180ms and decays 720ms; 20-frame isolated browser probe, 10 focused tests, 569 UI tests, UI audit and build PASS. Owner visual confirmation and full S6 gate remain pending. Direct Owner-running localhost:5173 probe also PASS, 20 frames/0 errors; separate reviewer partial PASS for ordinary liquid continuity, rapid sub-180ms repeated events unverified. 2026-10-15：当前分域流程板 S2–S5 机器门与异人复查均 PASS；S6 板显示台账 8/8 与平台复核 8/8，Owner 本会话称 S6 已完成。art-08 provenance 仍为 pending，须与平台记录核对；项目控制台 Owner 人门不由 agent 代签。
